statusLegend.VERIFIED: Read today from an official league or club source; source URL attached.
statusLegend.REPORTED: An official source confirms part of the fact; the exact value comes from a non-official source and is labelled as such.
statusLegend.ESTIMATED: No released schedule exists; value is projected from the most recent released season. NOT an official schedule.
statusLegend.UNRELEASED: League has not published it; no value supplied on purpose.

meta.headline: No 7-, 14- or 21-day window is conflict-free under the rule exactly as written in 2027, 2028 or 2029. The only rule change that creates a multi-week window is ignoring MLB spring training, which opens a 37-day 2027 run (Feb 15 – Mar 23) with verified official boundaries at both ends.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB spring training — first games
anchors.statusNote: MLB Stats API returns 17 spring-training games for 2027-02-19 and none for 2027-02-15..18. MLB's own press release announced the 2027 spring schedule; the API is the game-level evidence.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB Opening Night
anchors.value: Wed Mar 24, 2027 (single game, Netflix; matchup TBD)
anchors.statusNote: Read from MLB.com's 2027 schedule release story.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB traditional Opening Day
anchors.statusNote: Read from MLB.com's 2027 schedule release story.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB first full slate (all 30 clubs)
anchors.statusNote: Read from MLB.com's 2027 schedule release story.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB All-Star Game (97th) — Wrigley Field
anchors.statusNote: Confirmed by MLB.com release story and by the All-Star row present in the MLB Stats API 2027 snapshot.

anchors.label: 2027 T-Mobile Home Run Derby
anchors.statusNote: Not a game, but an official MLB event broadcast nationally. Listed because the brief asks for 'special MLB games'.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB second half begins
anchors.statusNote: MLB.com states the second half begins Thursday July 15; the All-Star break therefore has no regular-season games on Jul 12 or Jul 14, but Jul 13 has the All-Star Game itself.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB regular season — final day
anchors.statusNote: Read from MLB.com's 2027 schedule release story; matches the last regular-season date in the MLB Stats API snapshot.

anchors.label: 2027 MLB postseason (Wild Card → World Series)
anchors.statusNote: Not present in the official MLB feed on this date. The 2026 snapshot did carry postseason rows, so this is a coverage gap in the 2027 snapshot, not proof that no games occur. October 2027 must be treated as BUSY UNKNOWN.

anchors.label: NFL 2026 Week 18 window
anchors.value: Sat Jan 9 – Sun Jan 10, 2027 (exact kickoffs flexed)
anchors.statusNote: NFL Football Operations lists 'Week 18: January 9-10, 2027'. 49ers.com lists San Francisco's Week 18 game at Arizona as TBD. The stored NFL snapshot stops at Jan 3/4, 2027, so this week is missing from the dataset.

anchors.label: NFL Wild Card Weekend
anchors.statusNote: Official NFL Football Operations calendar.

anchors.label: NFL Divisional Playoffs
anchors.statusNote: Official NFL Football Operations calendar.

anchors.label: AFC and NFC Championship Games
anchors.statusNote: Official NFL Football Operations calendar.

anchors.label: Super Bowl LXI — last Westwood One NFL broadcast of the season
anchors.value: Sun Feb 14, 2027 · SoFi Stadium, Inglewood CA
anchors.statusNote: Official NFL Football Operations calendar. Westwood One is the NFL's official network radio partner and carries the Super Bowl; its own schedule page shows the 2026 package running through the postseason.

anchors.label: Pro Bowl
anchors.value: No AFC–NFC Pro Bowl game is staged from the 2026 season onward
anchors.statusNote: NFL announced the Pro Bowl Game will cease being contested; the league calendar for Jan/Feb 2027 contains no Pro Bowl date. Recorded as an exclusion, not a game.

anchors.label: 49ers terrestrial radio flagship (every game)
anchors.value: KNBR 680 AM / 104.5 FM and KSAN 107.7 FM
anchors.statusNote: Listed on every 2026 home and away game on the official 49ers.com schedule, including the TBD Week 18 game at Arizona.

anchors.label: NFL 2027 season schedule
anchors.statusNote: The 2027 NFL schedule has not been released. 49ers opponents are set by the rotation but dates/times are not published. Anything shown for Aug 2027 – Jan 2028 is ESTIMATED.

anchors.label: Stanford & Cal 2027 game dates and kickoff times
anchors.statusNote: Only opponents have been announced (Cal: Aug 28 window vs Sacramento State, Sep 4 at UCLA, Sep 11 vs Old Dominion; Stanford / Cal ACC slates announced by each school). Individual dates and kickoff times are not published, so late-August through November 2027 cannot be scored day by day.

anchors.label: Super Bowl LXII — host confirmed, date reported but not on NFL's own date table
anchors.statusNote: NFL.com confirms Atlanta / Mercedes-Benz Stadium as the LXII host, but NFL.com's own 'Upcoming Super Bowls' table still lists the LXII date as TBA. The Feb 13, 2028 date is reported by ESPN (Adam Schefter) and Pro Football Talk. Treat as high-confidence, not officially tabled.
anchors.sourceLabel: NFL.com — Atlanta to host Super Bowl LXII
anchors.extraSourceLabel: Non-official: Pro Football Talk on the Feb 13, 2028 date

anchors.label: 2027 NFL regular season length
anchors.value: 17-game regular season retained (18-game expansion not adopted for 2027)
anchors.statusNote: Reported by Pro Football Talk / Awful Announcing when the Feb 13, 2028 Super Bowl date was set. No official NFL release of the 2027 season format was located on this date.

anchors.label: MLB 2028 schedule
anchors.statusNote: MLB has not released a 2028 schedule. MLB Stats API returns totalItems 0 for 2028 on this date. Every 2028 MLB date below is ESTIMATED from the 2027 pattern.

anchors.label: 2028 MLB spring training — projected first games
anchors.statusNote: Projection. Spring training opened 2026-02-20 and opens 2027-02-19. Projected by holding the same weekday offset; MLB has not released a 2028 schedule.
anchors.sourceLabel: MLB Stats API 2027 (basis for the projection)

anchors.label: 2028 MLB Opening Day — projected
anchors.statusNote: Projection. 2027 Opening Night is Wed Mar 24; MLB has historically opened in the last week of March. Not a released date.
anchors.sourceLabel: MLB.com — 2027 schedule released (basis for the projection)

anchors.label: Super Bowl LXIII — host confirmed, date projected
anchors.value: ≈ Sun Feb 11, 2029 · Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas
anchors.statusNote: NFL.com confirms Las Vegas / Allegiant Stadium as the LXIII host but the announcement gives no firm date ('February 2029'). The Feb 11, 2029 date is the widely reported second Sunday of February 2029 and is shown as ESTIMATED, not as an NFL-announced date.
anchors.sourceLabel: NFL.com — Las Vegas to host Super Bowl LXIII

anchors.label: MLB 2029 schedule
anchors.statusNote: MLB has not released a 2029 schedule. MLB Stats API returns totalItems 0 for 2029 on this date. Every 2029 MLB date below is ESTIMATED.

anchors.label: 2029 MLB spring training — projected first games
anchors.statusNote: Projection from the 2026/2027 pattern. Not a released date.
anchors.sourceLabel: MLB Stats API 2027 (basis for the projection)

anchors.label: 2029 MLB Opening Day — projected
anchors.statusNote: Projection from the 2027 pattern. Not a released date.
anchors.sourceLabel: MLB.com — 2027 schedule released (basis for the projection)

mlbOnlyQuietRuns2027.note: This run runs to the end of the year because the official 2027 MLB snapshot stops at 2027-09-26. The 2027 postseason is NOT in the feed. This is a coverage gap and must be treated as BUSY, not free.
Starts before the first date present in the official MLB 2027 snapshot (2027-02-19); MLB has no games before spring training opens.

MLB.com says the 2027 second half begins Thursday July 15, but the MLB Stats API snapshot has no game on that date. The two official sources disagree, so Jul 15 is treated as BUSY and this run is scored as 1 day(s), not 2.
2027 MLB Opening Night (Netflix, matchup TBD) is announced by MLB.com but is not present in the MLB Stats API snapshot. Treat as BUSY.
